title: Pure Purrely
summary: Purrely cards only, with generic staples. Purrely and Purrelyly are Level 1 monsters that turn into Xyz Monsters by themselves. Purrely reveals a Memory Quick-Play Spell and becomes the Rank 2 Epurrely that mentions it, with the Spell as extra material. Each Memory Spell then gives that Xyz a new effect and summons another Level 1 Purrely from the Deck. The Epurrelys attach every Memory Spell you activate, and with five or more materials they rank straight into the Rank 7 Expurrelys. Expurrely Noir is unaffected by their effects, and Expurrely Happiness negates their whole board. Purrely Sharely!?, the newest card, swaps the Xyz for one of a different Attribute and copies its Memory Spell from the Deck. Purrely Delicious Memory and Purrely Sleepy Memory are Semi-Limited.
